card: This PR extracts low-level socket handling—including listening, outbound connections, polling, send/receive loops, and I2P session management—from CConnman into a new SockMan base class. CConnman implements event callbacks for P2P-specific protocol handling and changes its node storage from a vector to an unordered map keyed by NodeId. The change resolves issue #30694 to decouple networking I/O from P2P logic and enable potential reuse in Stratum v2 or RPC servers. Evidence of importance is limited to developer modularity and architectural goals cited by the author, with no reported bug or measurable user-facing performance gain.
evidence: Author states in the description that the PR addresses issue #30694 ("Split socket handling out of CConnman") to make socket handling modular and reusable for projects like Stratum V2 or a libevent-less HTTP server.
Commit 63751341d1 notes that switching node storage to an unordered map turns node lookups in DisconnectNode, ForNode, and AttemptToEvictConnection from O(N) into O(1).
problem: CConnman couples low-level socket I/O and OS polling with higher-level Bitcoin P2P protocol rules, address management, and peer eviction. This tight coupling complicates the networking code and prevents the socket event loop from being reused by other services such as Stratum v2 or an embedded HTTP server.
scope_notes: Large structural refactor (+1430/-751) moving networking code to src/common/sockman.cpp and src/common/sockman.h, and moving i2p.cpp into bitcoin_common. Changing CConnman::m_nodes from a vector to an unordered map alters node iteration order, requiring an adjustment to peer eviction logic in PeerManagerImpl::EvictExtraOutboundPeers.
summary: Extracts low-level socket operations (listening, connecting, event loops, send/recv, and I2P SAM sessions) out of CConnman into a new SockMan class located in common/. CConnman inherits from SockMan and handles Bitcoin P2P logic through event-driven virtual callbacks. In addition, CConnman converts its internal node storage from a vector to an unordered_map keyed by NodeId for faster lookups.
